scope: Bounded reconciliation of the two shipped Expat copies after correcting the NVD vendor to libexpat_project. No broad library audit or underlying binary fix is claimed.

scanner_receipt.result: 30 findings individually classified in security/native-audit-triage.json; no unreviewed Expat findings

source_observations: FcConfigParseAndLoadFromMemoryInternal creates a fresh UTF-8 XML_ParserCreate parser without a namespace separator and frees it after parsing.
XML_GetBuffer(BUFSIZ) precedes each XML_ParseBuffer call; each supplied length is at most BUFSIZ.
No XML_ExternalEntityParserCreate, parser reset/resume, or unknown encoding handler is imported; active-parser callbacks do not feed/free/reset it.
The shipped closure has no xmlwf executable.
gstreamer.trust_boundary: The only native consumer parses service-local Fontconfig configuration. CivicCast media/font/PDF/CAP/RSS input is not passed as Fontconfig XML, and product code exposes no Fontconfig XML upload/parse-from-memory route. If an untrusted principal can alter the service Fontconfig files/environment, these applicability decisions must be revisited; the underlying2.7.1 library remains vulnerable for arbitrary untrusted configuration XML.

python.reset: No XML_ParserReset call or wrapper is present in pinned Modules/pyexpat.c or Modules/_elementtree.c; Lib/xml/sax/expatreader.py reset creates another ParserCreate. Actual runtime ParserCreate object exposes no Reset method.
reproduced_before_fix: CAP accepted an internal entity declaration.
RSS accepted a DTD placed after5000leading spaces, beyond the existing4096character prefix guard.
python.correction: Both supported untrusted feed parsers use existing defusedxml with forbid_dtd=True and forbid_entities=True; CAP preserves empty-list refusal and RSS preserves ValueError refusal/cache fallback. vMix already uses defusedxml entity rejection. Other stdlib parse sites consume generated exports/local validator reports.
python.actual_runtime_proof: Both malicious declaration payloads were rejected using the actual source-built3.12.16 interpreter/Expat2.9.0, with project modules and existing pure-Python defusedxml loaded from the pinned development environment.
python.verification: 29 focused CAP/RSS/inventory tests passed; Ruff passed.
